trl_rationale: Full-scale structural test article built; materials and subassemblies proof-tested and inflation deployment demonstrated in the lab at low pressure. Full-pressure (9 psi) testing is still future work.

evidence.quote: This was an extremely efficient deployment approach that was easily repeatable in the lab.
The average tensile strength of the samples was 38,740lb, with a minimum breaking strength for a single seam sample of 18,690lb.
Each webbing was taken to 1.5 times the expected loading conditions in the fixture seen in Figure 5.7.
